frozen_before: download of candidate report and any target value inspection

candidate_source.title: Compressor Calorimeter Test of R-410A Alternatives R-32, DR-5, and L-41A Using a Scroll Compressor
candidate_source.use: Appendix experimental tables only; no fitted-coefficient tables or derived points

datasets.pooling: none; each refrigerant/suction-condition table is a separate dataset

admission.speed: measured per-point speed, else nominal_mechanical_rpm = 60*rated_volume_rate/displacement from report; never infer rpm from supply frequency
admission.pressure: report absolute pressure preferred; else CoolProp dew pressure from reported dew temperature, flagged
admission.targets: measured mass flow and electrical power from the same table cell; blank cells excluded
admission.phase: CoolProp single-phase gas suction for all points

split.order: first n test, next n calibration, rest train

methods.intervals: group-max split conformal 90% for semiempirical and semiempirical_rbf on the same calibration groups

criteria.B_correction: RBF MARE lower than base on both responses
criteria.C_vs_strongest_baseline: max(response MARE) of RBF <= AHRI10 (affine if AHRI10 unavailable)
criteria.D_intervals: report coverage and width only; no pass/fail

secondary_design.budgets: hull count, 12, 16, 24, all training groups; only values <= training pool
secondary_design.criterion: kernel_ivr max-response MARE below maximin in a majority of (budget x dataset) cells

discipline: single scoring run; any later correction is a new labelled non-blind version
